parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the stream belongs. The AppName must match the AppName in the ingest URL for the template to take effect. To match all AppName values, set this parameter to *
parameters.help_zh: 播流所属应用名称。AppName名称与推流地址中的AppName名称对应，模板才能生效。若不限制AppName可填*，即可匹配所有AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en:
The stream name. The StreamName must match the StreamName in the ingest URL for the template to take effect. To match all StreamName values, set this parameter to *.

The stream must have had actual stream ingest activity under the specified DomainName and AppName. Otherwise, the InvalidStream.NotFound error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
播流名称。StreamName名称与推流地址中的StreamName名称对应，模板才能生效。若不限制StreamName可填*，即可匹配所有StreamName。

该流必须曾在此 DomainName + AppName 下发生过真实推流行为，否则返回 InvalidStream.NotFound
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en: The endpoint of the OSS bucket
parameters.name: oss_endpoint

parameters.help_en: The name of the OSS bucket
parameters.name: oss_bucket

parameters.help_en: The name of the recording file stored in OSS
parameters.name: oss_object

parameters.help_en: The start time of the index file. TS files uploaded after this time are included in the index file. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 索引文件的开始时间。ts文件的上传时间在此之后则会被包含进索引文件。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the index file. TS files uploaded before this time are included in the index file. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 索引文件的结束时间。ts文件的上传时间在此之前则会被包含进索引文件。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include the end time. If you set this parameter to true, the system attempts to include one additional TS file so that the created index file fully covers the period between StartTime and EndTime
parameters.help_zh: 是否包含结束时间。传true会尝试多包含一个ts文件，创建的索引文件会完整覆盖StartTime和EndTime
parameters.name: end_time_included
